text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... is the "BNW" live event really 
going to be canceled...?

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh?! But we came all this way just for 
this! I can't give up! Let's wait a bit 
longer, okay?

On my day off, I visited the shopping mall 
to watch a live show, only to find a huge 
commotion in the area. Just then――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer spotted~! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're wondering what happened too, right, 
Trainer? In that case, take off with Maya♪

Dragged along by Mayano Top Gun toward the 
center of the fuss, I found Biwa Hayahide 
with a troubled look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
――However, imagine how disappointed 
everyone who came today would be if we 
were to cancel it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I cannot perform a full 
live concert alone. In that case, if we 
can devise a plan to buy some time until 
the other two arrive...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! What's wrong, Hayahide-san? Are you 
in trouble?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You two... I apologize for letting you see 
me in such an unseemly state. To tell the 
truth――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~! Ticket-san and the other can't 
make it to the venue?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the trains have stopped 
running. Fortunately, having gone ahead to 
scout the venue, I arrived safely, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Today's plan is a "BNW" live event. 
Naturally, the setlist was arranged for 
three performers. Therefore――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing I can do on my own... 
Guh... To have to cancel after preparing 
so extensively for this day...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Hayahide-san. Would it be okay if 
Maya helped out?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's their day off! Letting 
everyone end up disappointed is a big 
no-no!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So Maya wants to give everyone a present!
choice_data_list: Is that also an "un-special day present"?

text_block_list.text:
Hearing her mention a present, I 
remembered how Mayano Top Gun had given 
Oguri Cap a present before.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That was, like, an "un-special day 
present" from Maya to Oguri-san♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Close! This one is a "special present for 
a wonderful day off"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Papa doesn't just have one kind of 
present. There are sparkling sunny day 
presents, secret presents to hide from 
Mama, and all sorts of others!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So today, Maya's gonna give a present that 
turns a ruined day off into a wonderful 
one!
choice_data_list:
Even so, we're still short one member, 
aren't we?

Even so, we're still missing one person, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Trainer is here too, so that 
makes three of us♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're an Academy Trainer, right? 
Then of course you can sing the concert 
songs♪

Things had escalated wildly, but there was 
no helping it. Steel myself, I decided to 
step onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
――Taishin and Ticket are heading this way 
with everything they've got right now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So~, in the meantime, Maya and the gang 
are gonna sing with her instead♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna give everyone a sparkling, 
wonderful day off as a present~!

text_block_list.name: Audience Member A
text_block_list.text:
I came here to see BNW, but... Well, I 
guess this is better than canceling...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Hehehe♪ Let's match the lyrics here and 
do a cute turn~)

text_block_list.name: Audience Member B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Isn't Mayano Top Gun-chan super 
full of energy and insanely cute?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Keep these steps bouncy! Ehehe, I'm 
getting super pumped up!)

text_block_list.name: Audience Member C
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! Her dance sharpness is insane! 
She's so ridiculously cool!!

text_block_list.name: Audience Member D
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... that sidelong glance just now 
made my heart skip a beat. To think she 
can be that cute and seductive at the same 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Mayano-kun... Her live 
performance is truly "ever-changing." I 
cannot afford to be outdone!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, don't take your eyes 
off this special, today-only unit――!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Cute Maya, cool Maya, every single one is 
a present for all of you♪

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Audience Member A
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is awesome... Man, maybe I 
should go watch her races next time...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... ...What do you know, the 
crowd's actually hyped.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, incredible! We can't let them beat 
us either! All right, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay, now everyone's here! All right 
everyone~, let's get even more hyped up♪

The special collaboration between BNW and 
Mayano Top Gun proved to be a huge 
success, trending at number one on social 
media that day.
